_comment: APPROVED_EMBEDDING_MODELS — single source of truth for all embedding model options.
To ADD a model    : append a new entry and set 'enabled': true.
To REMOVE a model : set 'enabled': false (preferred) or delete the entry.
Setting enabled=false keeps the audit trail intact.
id           — HuggingFace model ID used as the 'const' value in JSON Schema
title        — Short human-readable label shown in the UI dropdown
description  — Markdown-formatted detail shown in the UI tooltip / detail pane
default      — Exactly ONE entry may have default=true (the pre-selected value)
enabled      — false = hidden from UI; the entry remains for audit purposes
hf_url       — HuggingFace model card URL for reference
added_date   — ISO date the model was added
removed_date — ISO date the model was disabled (null while active)

models.title: CLIP ViT-B/32 (multimodal image + text)
models.description:
**Modalities:** Image + Text (512-d vectors for both)

**Use Cases:** Image similarity search, Cross-modal retrieval, Oracle 26ai vector sidecar

**Strengths:** Dual-modal (image and text in the same embedding space), Compact 512-d output, Efficient ViT-B/32 architecture

**⚠ Note:** DMG approval pending. Use at your own risk.

models.title: Granite Embedding 278M Multilingual
models.description:
**Languages:** Multilingual (100+ languages)

**Use Cases:** Cross-lingual semantic search, Multilingual document retrieval, International content matching

**Strengths:** Excellent multilingual support, Efficient 278M parameter model, Strong performance across diverse languages

models.title: ResNet-18 (image classification)
models.description:
**Modalities:** Image (512-d vectors)

**Use Cases:** Image feature extraction, Visual similarity search, Lightweight image embeddings

**Strengths:** Very fast inference, Small footprint (11M parameters), Good baseline for image similarity tasks

models.title: ResNet-50 (image classification)
models.description:
**Modalities:** Image (2048-d vectors)

**Use Cases:** Image feature extraction, Visual similarity search, Transfer learning backbone

**Strengths:** Strong image representations (25M parameters), Well-established benchmark performance, Widely used in production

models.title: ResNet-101 (image classification)
models.description:
**Modalities:** Image (2048-d vectors)

**Use Cases:** High-quality image feature extraction, Fine-grained visual similarity, Large-scale image retrieval

**Strengths:** Higher accuracy than ResNet-50 (44M parameters), Deeper residual network, Strong ImageNet-trained representations

models.title: ViT-Base Patch16 224 (Vision Transformer)
models.description:
**Modalities:** Image (768-d vectors)

**Use Cases:** Image classification embeddings, Visual feature extraction, Semantic image retrieval

**Strengths:** Transformer-based image understanding (86M parameters), Patch-based attention mechanism, Strong transfer learning capability

models.title: ViT-Base Patch16 384 (Vision Transformer, high-res)
models.description:
**Modalities:** Image (768-d vectors)

**Use Cases:** High-resolution image embeddings, Fine-detail image retrieval, Visual quality assessment

**Strengths:** Higher input resolution (384×384) than 224 variant, Better fine-grained detail capture, Same efficient ViT-Base architecture

models.title: ViT-Large Patch16 224 (Vision Transformer, large)
models.description:
**Modalities:** Image (1024-d vectors)

**Use Cases:** High-accuracy image embeddings, Premium visual similarity search, Large-scale visual retrieval

**Strengths:** Larger model capacity (307M parameters), Superior image representations, Higher downstream task accuracy

models.title: BEiT-Base Patch16 384 (BERT pre-training of ViTs)
models.description:
**Modalities:** Image (768-d vectors)

**Use Cases:** Self-supervised image embeddings, High-resolution image retrieval, Vision pre-training tasks

**Strengths:** BERT-style masked image modelling pre-training, High-resolution 384×384 input, Strong self-supervised representations

models.title: BEiT-Base Patch16 224 PT22K-FT22K (ImageNet-22K)
models.description:
**Modalities:** Image (768-d vectors)

**Use Cases:** Broad category image retrieval, ImageNet-22K class embeddings, General-purpose image similarity

**Strengths:** Pre-trained and fine-tuned on ImageNet-22K (21,841 classes), Richer visual vocabulary than ImageNet-1K models, Strong general-purpose image features

models.title: BEiT-Large Patch16 224 PT22K-FT22K (ImageNet-22K)
models.description:
**Modalities:** Image (1024-d vectors)

**Use Cases:** Premium image similarity search, High-accuracy visual retrieval, Enterprise-grade image embeddings

**Strengths:** Large model capacity (307M parameters), ImageNet-22K pre-training and fine-tuning, Best-in-class BEiT image representations

models.title: all-mpnet-base-v2 (Sentence Transformers)
models.description:
**Modalities:** Text (768-d vectors)

**Use Cases:** Semantic text search, Sentence-level similarity, Semantic clustering and deduplication

**Strengths:** State-of-the-art general-purpose text embeddings, Fine-tuned on 1B+ sentence pairs, Top-ranked on SBERT benchmarks for English semantic search
